schema.description:
UpdateWarmPoolRequest updates a warm pool. Scalars are updated when set;
the repeated and structured fields are replaced only when their update_*
switch is set (UpdateTemplateRequest's convention). A configuration change
invalidates the current warm sessions: the reconciler replaces them.

deviceSpec.description: New device override (unset clears it), applied when update_device_spec is true.

coldBoot.description:
Android only: boot the emulator cold (-no-snapshot-load) and never save a
quickboot snapshot, so every open exercises a full first boot.

cores.description:
Android only: emulator CPU core count. 0 = sized to the host (cores/2,
clamped). Same mint bound + on-VM clamp as ram_mb.

deviceModel.description: Device profile hint (for example, "pixel_7"). Empty = platform default.

osVersion.description:
iOS only: the simulator runtime to boot, as an iOS version such as "18.2"
(or a simctl runtime id). Anything else, and any value on Android, is
rejected. Empty = the newest installed runtime. Reads back as the version.

platform.description:
Device platform: "android" (emulator, Linux stacks) or "ios" (simulator,
macOS stacks).

ramMb.description:
Android only: emulator RAM in MB. 0 = sized to the host (RAM/4, clamped).
Bounded at mint against the machine type's specs; clamped again on the VM
with a degradation notice if the host cannot honor it.

systemImage.description:
Android only: sdkmanager system image package (for example,
"system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64"). Empty = platform
default. Images not pre-installed on the stack fall back to the best
installed one with a viewer-visible degradation notice — they are never
downloaded at boot.

enabledFeatureFlagNames.description: New enabled feature flags, applied when update_enabled_feature_flag_names is true.

machineType.description: New machine type override ("" clears it).

poolSize.description: New pool size. 0 drains the pool.

sessionInputs.description:
New session input values, applied when update_session_inputs is true.
The list GetWarmPool returns can be sent back as is: a direct secret
input with an empty value keeps the pool's stored secret for that key
(a new value or a saved-input reference replaces it; leaving the key out
removes the input).

items.description:
SessionInputValue provides a value for a session input when creating a session.
Either provide a direct value or reference a saved input by ID (for secrets).

isSecret.description: Whether the value is secret (encrypt at rest). Ignored if saved_input_id is set.

key.description: Key name matching a session input on the template.

savedInputId.description:
Optional: ID of a Saved Input to use. Backend fetches and decrypts the value server-side.
This avoids exposing secret values to the frontend.

value.description: Direct value (used when user typed in a value). Ignored if saved_input_id is set.

updateDeviceSpec.description: Replace the device override with device_spec.

updateSessionInputs.description: Replace the session inputs with session_inputs.
